title: Stripe HubSpot Integration: Setup Guide (2026)
summary: Stripe HubSpot integration syncs customers and payments through the native app, then add workflows for additional automation needs.
body_markdown:
## Connect Stripe to HubSpot in four stages


Work through four stages and the native app is syncing. Each leaves something you can check before moving on, which matters because **email's the matching key** and **a bad first sync is hard to undo** .


### Install the app from the HubSpot marketplace


Sign in to HubSpot with a user who has permission to install apps, open the App Marketplace from the main navigation, and search for Stripe. Choose the listing published by Stripe, then select Install app.


Done means the app appears in your connected apps list. Nothing syncs yet, and that's the correct state.


### Authorise Stripe and choose what to sync


Partway through the install you land in Stripe to approve access. Use a Stripe login that can authorise third-party apps, and confirm you're in the right Stripe account before approving, since the wrong one's the commonest cause of "the data is missing" tickets.


Back in HubSpot, pick which objects to sync, such as customers and payments, and review how Stripe fields map to HubSpot properties.


Sync only what a report or a workflow will use, because every extra object is another thing to audit. Done means the connection shows as active with your chosen objects listed.


### Confirm the first customer and payment appear


Pick a Stripe customer you know well, ideally one who has paid, and search for their email in HubSpot contacts. You should see one contact, not two, with payment information attached.


If you see a second contact, compare the email Stripe holds with the one HubSpot holds.


**Don't trust a "sync complete" status as proof.** Open the records.


### Test with a Stripe test-mode payment


Before real customers depend on this, create a payment in Stripe's test mode using an email address that already exists as a HubSpot contact. Then watch whether it matches.


Test mode may not flow through the app at all, so treat a silent absence as a finding, not a failure of your setup.


If test data does sync, delete the test contact afterwards so it doesn't pollute lists. If it doesn't, run one small real payment on a staff email instead, and note the result.
